scope: Read-only post-render audit lane for EvidenceProse companion cards
purpose: Verify both the visual topology and every reader-visible material content node against the audited truth boundary, final queue/spec, and bound primary source.

hard_rules: Presence of the right overall concept is never sufficient to pass a rendered card.
Every material visual relation must be reconciled edge by edge.
Every reader-visible material content node, category, example, label, number, citation and source-defined list member must receive exactly one source-surface disposition.
A plausible but untraceable added category is a material failure, not a warning.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: bind_primary_literature
must: bind the primary source when available
inspect source figure/table directly when a rendered relation or closed set derives from it

mandatory_audit_sop.name: build_expected_semantic_structure_and_surface_packet
must: expected visual graph including branch conditions and terminal states
expected source-surface inventory for every material category/example/list member the source or final queue actually authorizes

mandatory_audit_sop.name: blind_render_readback
must: read all visible text, numbers and citations
extract every material content node including standalone examples/categories/icons whose label carries scientific meaning
extract every material edge with source/target/direction/type/condition
extract branch points and terminal/non-terminal behavior
assign stable observed_node_id to each material content node before source comparison

mandatory_audit_sop.name: visual_topology_reconciliation
must: check source node, target node, direction, relation type, branch condition, branch parent and terminal-state continuation
never pass by concept presence alone

mandatory_audit_sop.name: source_surface_node_closure
must: disposition every observed material content node exactly once
for each node record primary_source_support_status and at least one source locator when supported
distinguish semantic paraphrase from a newly added category/example
check source-defined list membership and cardinality
forbid topic-plausibility as a substitute for source support

material_failure_rules.SOURCE_SUPPORTED_BUT_NOT_QUEUE_AUTHORIZE: FAIL_RENDER unless the queue explicitly permits renderer-authored examples/categories

mandatory_audit_sop.name: derive_per_card_verdict
mandatory_audit_sop.rule: PASS is illegal unless both topology closure and source-surface node closure are complete and all substantive axes pass.

mandatory_audit_sop.name: repair_and_human_display
must: every FAIL_RENDER/FAIL_SPEC gets executable repair ticket
substantial structural/content change gets supported replacement material
project all failed-card repair instructions into exactly one writing block

source_surface_gate.material_node_definition: Any visible text, category, example, icon-label pair, list member, number, citation, population, context, outcome, intervention, mechanism or relationship-type whose presence can change the reader's scientific understanding.
closure_rules: Every observed material node appears exactly once in content_node_checks.
Every expected source-defined closed-set member appears exactly once in expected_content_checks.
A broad queue statement such as 'more diverse samples are needed' does not authorize arbitrary specific populations or contexts.
Scientific plausibility, domain familiarity, or support from adjacent literature does not satisfy primary-source support for a card bound to one source.
If a renderer invents a specific member that the queue did not authorize and the bound source does not support, SOURCE_SURFACE=fail and verdict=FAIL_RENDER.

verdicts.PASS: all substantive axes pass; topology closure and source-surface node closure are complete
verdicts.FAIL_RENDER: sound expected science/spec, but rendered image materially changes, invents or adds unsupported content/topology/source structure/traceability
verdicts.FAIL_SPEC: render faithfully reflects a materially wrong upstream spec/truth/source binding
verdicts.BLOCK_UNVERIFIABLE: material source/identity/render relation cannot be checked without guessing

regression_cases.C02_WRONG_BRANCH_SOURCE: Retained from v1.0: wrong branch parent must FAIL_RENDER even when labels are correct.
regression_cases.C02_PLAUSIBLE_UNSOURCED_CATEGORY: If a card about narrow attachment-and-sex research adds 'pregnancy/postpartum context' as a research-gap category while the final queue did not authorize it and Dewitte 2020 does not support it, the card must FAIL_RENDER. The fact that pregnancy/postpartum is plausible or relevant in the wider attachment literature is irrelevant to this bound-source audit.

human_repair_display.ordinary_chat_rule: Outside the writing block, report only verdict/count/card-id summary; do not duplicate the repair body.
